title: Net Worth Certificate Printable PDF | Personalized Financial Print — Assets, Liabilities & Net Worth Statement | Digital Download
description:
A CERTIFICATE THAT PUTS YOUR NUMBERS ON THE WALL.

What you get: a one-page certificate of net worth: your name, the as-of date, assets, liabilities, and net worth — calculated and printed with thousands separators, framed by a classic certificate border, with a signature line to sign and date. Frame it — this money print turns a number into a milestone. Print a fresh one each year as your personal wealth tracker and watch the line move.

Why this one is different: the numbers are calculated, not hand-written. Assets minus liabilities is done for you — and if the result is negative, it is shown honestly, never hidden.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- One-page certificate, US Letter + A4 sizes (both included)
- Name + as-of date printed on the certificate
- Assets − liabilities = net worth, calculated to the cent
- Thousands separators on every amount
- Signature + date lines
- Classic double-border certificate frame

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy, download, and open the PDF.
2. Print US Letter or A4 — both are included.
3. Enter your name, date, assets and liabilities, generate, print, sign.

You receive: 1 PDF file (2 sizes). No physical item ships — this is an instant download. Images show sample data.

Organizational tools, not legal or financial documents. Not legal advice — verify requirements with your state or a licensed professional.
